title: feat: add DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp as a new Fireworks text and image model.
- Uses the exact Fireworks vision checkpoint with no aliases or fallback.
- Sets paidOnly false and a 1x price multiplier at $0.22/M input, $0.007/M cached input, and $0.66/M output.
- Updates MODEL_SLUGS.md and effective-price coverage.
- Verifies the route with resolver, registry, permission, catalog, pricing, snapshot, typecheck, local catalog, and direct Fireworks vision probes.

gist.headline: A fresh pair of eyes
gist.blurb: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision just landed in the hive. Send it text and images; it will inspect both without requiring an alias scavenger hunt.
gist.summary: Added the Fireworks checkpoint `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` as a paidOnly-false text-and-image model, priced at $0.22/M input tokens, $0.007/M cached input tokens, and $0.66/M output tokens.
gist.impact: Developers can now use DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision directly for multimodal prompts through the model registry, with catalog, permissions, pricing, and resolver support already wired in.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears tiny explorer binoculars while helping the eager CRT Monitor Robot examine a glowing image-and-text specimen at a cozy terminal. The scene represents a vision model reading both pictures and words, with code-plants and small flowers growing around the Fireworks-connected workstation.
